title: Ekos Scheduler Missed Imaging Windows
dataSources: NINA sequences (`nina:sequence`), NINA autofocus runs (`nina:autofocus`), Ekos scheduler and device events (`ekos:scheduler`, `ekos:device`), PHD2 guiding telemetry (`phd2:guide`), plate solves (`platesolve:run`), filter wheel events (`filterwheel:event`), and flat frames (`flatlib:frame`).
app: Astrophotography session telemetry from N.I.N.A., KStars/Ekos, PHD2, plate-solving tools, ASCOM gear, and filter-wheel controllers sent to Splunk HEC via logs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ekos:scheduler
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(window_status="captured")) as successful by _time target_name
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for Ekos scheduler windows by target.
value: Window capture success shows whether the scheduler is taking advantage of the nights you planned for.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for Ekos scheduler windows events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for Ekos scheduler windows by target.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how often Ekos scheduler windows works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
